title: Pornography Is Not Free Speech, It's Cultural Poison
author: Noble, O. Alan
source: The Ways of a Gentleman, February 7, 2026
summary: Pornography is not merely a personal choice or protected speech—it is a systemic poison that degrades both the consumers and the women in the industry. As parents raise the next generation of boys and men, they must understand that pornography rewires the brain, distorts sexuality, and creates unrealistic and demeaning expectations of women. The normalization of pornography in youth culture has contributed to rises in erectile dysfunction, delayed maturity, and objectification of women. A father's responsibility includes protecting his sons from this poison and raising them to understand that true manhood is built on respect, restraint, and the capacity for healthy relationships.
points: Pornography systematically harms both users and the women exploited in its production.
Early exposure to pornography distorts adolescent development and creates unhealthy patterns in adulthood.
Fathers must actively protect their sons from pornography as part of their responsibility to raise healthy men.
Cultural acceptance of pornography has increased rates of erectile dysfunction and relational dysfunction in young men.
